'''Imperial Marines''' were [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]] that primarily served on [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] as defence provided by the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized these [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to board [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. They acted as "'''the punch'''" of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]].

==Overview==
Imperial Marines carried an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], a [[MiniMag shoulder-launched proton torpedo launcher]], and multiple [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] as standard equipment.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> They also utilized [[Laser cutter/Legends|cutting lasers]] and an explosive charge to breach enemy vessels, and could also carry smoke pellets and [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenades]].<ref name="IHB" /> They were generally the first boarding party on captured [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==History==
Imperial Marines were a specialized variant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] that was active during the period after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sharing a similar role to that of the [[clone marine]]s that preceded them within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Imperial Marines were [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]] used by the Empire to defend [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] such as [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. They were also used to sabotage or capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] capital ships after being ferried over to them during a space battle.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[File:BF_Mustafar_Hangar.jpg|thumb|230px|left|Imperial Marines of the 501st Legion defend against a boarding party of Gizor Dellso's forces during the Battle of Mustafar.]]
During the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, several marines fought under command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Lord Vader's Persuasion">[[:File:Lord-vaders-persuasion.jpg|Lord Vader's Persuasion]] by Dave Dorman</ref> Sometime between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' specifies that "[[Standard year/Legends|years]]" passed between the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and the battle on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Given that ''Battlefront II'' additionally places the Mustafar battle before the [[Kamino uprising]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]], the Mustafar battle must therefore take place between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>, Imperial Marines from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were deployed in the [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Battle of Mustafar]] against the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] led by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Gizor Dellso]]. During the ensuing battle, an [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]] was able to board the 501st's Star Destroyer, deploying several [[Droid marine]]s and [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|battle droid pilots]] which were repelled by Imperial Marines.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[Nova Stihl]] served as a [[Guard Sergeant]] in the Imperial Marines before his death in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Imperial marines were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. Off-duty marines frequented the [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] of [[The Strip]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]] and were territorial of the establishments, disliking outsiders who came into the bars asking questions.<ref name="Plant">{{WEGCite|story=The Plant|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Marines first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Missions 4: Destroy the Liquidator]]''. In the [[2005]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', Imperial Marines are one of the classes used during space combat in the Imperial portion of the campaign and during Galactic Conquest and space skirmish missions. In ''Battlefront II'' they have different roles in space combat than Pilots. Unlike Pilots, the Marines cannot repair the ships they fly, being used specifically for fast boarding actions.

''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', the strategy guide to the [[2001]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', incorrectly states that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] led the Imperial Marines at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
